name: 03-stage-map
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Premium polished videogame UI concept for Virtual Runners, a joyful 1990s anime side-scrolling runner with existing cel-painted chibi characters. Brand '晴空跑道': bright open SKY, CLOUD WHITE and SUNSHINE ORANGE. Palette #23B5E8, #116F95, #FF8A3D, #FFFFFF, #ECF8FC, dark text #163A4B, reward yellow #F5C949. Rounded wayfinding signs, circular route nodes, pill-shaped distance markers, thin deep-lake-blue outlines and soft short shadows. Clear spacious hierarchy, large readable Traditional Chinese, functional consistent UI. Flat cel colors, no chrome or metallic letters, no black brush panels, no volleyball/sports-team shield, no navy-gold theme, no app-store ad/purchases, no floating confetti everywhere. Clean typography, no illegible tiny labels. Full-bleed landscape 16:9 screen, preferably 1920x1080 or higher, no device frame. Use reference for exact color/style/rounded signs. Create a single polished LEVEL SELECT screen, title '關卡地圖', illustrated overview of white city rooftops, clocktower, bridges, canals, green trees and gentle hills under a clear blue sky. A curved elevated route winds through the city, with EXACTLY EIGHT prominent connected circular nodes, in ordered reading sequence '1-1','1-2','1-3','1-4','1-5','1-6','1-7','1-8'. Nodes1 and2 completed blue with three gold stars; node3 selected orange with focus ring; nodes4-7 muted blue-gray with small locks yet number labels visible; node8 has lock and small boss silhouette icon. NO duplicate stage numbers, NO extra large nodes. Top row SIX compact world tabs with distinct icons and names: '白色都市' selected, '草原森林', '水下世界', '冰山', '火炎礦坑', '邪惡城堡'. Lower right overlay only 24% wide white info card, not obscuring route: '1-3' '天台夜路', three empty star outlines, orange '開始跑' button. Lower-left back pill '返回'. City route is main visual, labels crisp, icon-based future locked worlds. No combat or generic mobile game shop bars; this is existing 48-level runner with 8 levels per world. Full 16:9 UI screenshot, no device bezel.
